propositions.option_text: An unrelated adult with no qualifying authority substitutes a purported partial-fill request for the minor patient’s parent or guardian.
propositions.finding_ko: Federal requested-partial의 미성년자 대리 요청은 parent/legal guardian 등 명시된 적격 주체다. 보기에서 qualifying authority 없다고 한 unrelated adult에게 권한을 보태지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist applies the CII shortage deadline to a Schedule IV partial fill instead of the applicable III–V conditions.
propositions.finding_ko: III-V partial에는 refill 방식의 기록, 총 처방량 이내, issue 후6개월 조건이 적용된다. CII shortage의72시간을 CIV에 그대로 적용할 수 없다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: After 72 hours, the pharmacist supplies the shortage remainder because the original prescription is still within its ordinary 30-day validity.
propositions.finding_ko: Stock shortage의72시간 remainder 제한은 first partial filling부터이고 일반30일 validity가 남아 있어도 넘길 수 없다. 이후는 새 prescription이 필요하다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
Current Massachusetts Legislature text retrieved 2026-11-03

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist counts each partial fill as a new full quantity authorization.
propositions.finding_ko: Partial 각각은 원 처방 총량 일부이며 새로운 full quantity authorization이 아니다. Combined quantity를 추적해야 한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacy converts an undocumented stock shortage into a patient-requested partial after its shortage clock expires.
propositions.finding_ko: Undocumented stock shortage를 시계 만료 뒤 소급하여 patient request로 분류하는 것은 실제 request·기록 요건을 충족하지 않는다. Practitioner의 적법한 subsequent request 경로와도 구별한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: For an emergency oral CII requested partial, the pharmacist distinguishes the 72-hour period measured from issuance from the non-emergency 30-day period.
propositions.finding_ko: Requested CII partial의 federal remainder는 일반 written prescription이면 written date후30일, emergency oral이면 issuance후72시간이다. Shortage의 first partial filling 기준과 구별한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist uses one full refill authorization for each small partial transaction, even while dividing the quantity of the original fill.
propositions.finding_ko: 원 fill의 authorized quantity를 나누는 partial transaction마다 새 full refill authorization을 소진시키는 처리가 아니다. 기록은 refill처럼 유지하되 quantity와 authorization을 구분한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A parent or legal guardian requests a permitted partial fill for a minor patient under the federal rule.
propositions.finding_ko: Federal rule은 미성년자 parent 또는 legal guardian의 partial request를 명시적으로 허용한다. 보기의 permitted와 all-other prerequisites를 적용하며, 무권한 성인 일반에게 확장하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A Massachusetts pharmacy directs a different pharmacy to finish the patient-requested CII remainder as a routine refill transfer.
propositions.finding_ko: MA patient-requested CII remainder는 initial partial을 조제한 동일 pharmacy만 공급할 수 있다. CII refill이 되거나 routine refill transfer로 바뀌지 않는다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register #1531, footer9/27/2024
Current Massachusetts Legislature text retrieved 2026-11-03
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: For a stock-shortage CII partial, the pharmacist starts a new 72-hour period when the replacement stock arrives.
propositions.finding_ko: Stock shortage의72시간은 first partial filling에서 시작한다. Replacement stock 입고로 재시작하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: After the shortage remainder cannot be completed within 72 hours, the pharmacist notifies the prescriber and requires a new prescription for later supply.
propositions.finding_ko: Shortage remainder를72시간 내 완료하지 못하면 prescriber에게 notify하고 그 이후 공급은 new prescription을 요구한다. 이전72시간 내에 적법하게 준 양을 소급 취소하는 규칙은 아니다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist keeps the combined quantities of all partial fills within the total authorized quantity.
propositions.finding_ko: 모든 partial의 합계는 total quantity prescribed를 넘지 않아야 한다. Partial 횟수가 새 authorization을 만들지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: For a valid patient-requested non-emergency CII partial, the pharmacist measures 30 days from each later partial dispensing.
propositions.finding_ko: Non-emergency requested CII remainder의30일은 prescription written/issue date 기준이다. 각 later dispensing부터 새30일을 계산하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
Mass.Register #1531, footer9/27/2024

propositions.option_text: For a stock-shortage CII partial, the pharmacist tracks the 72-hour remainder period from the first partial filling.
propositions.finding_ko: Shortage CII partial의 remainder72시간은 first partial filling에서 계산한다. Requested-partial emergency의 issuance기산점과 구분한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: For a valid patient-requested non-emergency CII partial, the pharmacist measures the 30-day federal remainder limit from the issue date.
propositions.finding_ko: 적격 patient-requested non-emergency CII remainder의 federal30일은 처방 written date 기준이며 MA도 issue date후30일이다. Later partial로 연장하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
Mass.Register #1531, footer9/27/2024

propositions.option_text: A Massachusetts pharmacy completes a qualifying patient-requested CII remainder at the same pharmacy that supplied the initial partial.
propositions.finding_ko: MA qualifying patient-requested CII remainder는 initial partial을 공급한 같은 pharmacy에서 해야 한다. 기한·총량·기록 등 나머지 요건은 Stem에서 충족한다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register #1531, footer9/27/2024
Current Massachusetts Legislature text retrieved 2026-11-03

propositions.option_text: An ordinary technician processes a newly proposed dose change as an unchanged refill authorization.
propositions.finding_ko: Ordinary technician은 pharmacist 승인 아래 unchanged refill을 요청·수신할 수 있지만, 새 dose change를 변경 없는 refill로 처리하거나 therapy modification을 수행할 수 없다.

authorities.version: 4/25/2025 corrected publication, printed Effective4/6/2018

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist treats the legal maximum of five refills as permission for five additional fills when the prescriber authorized none.
propositions.finding_ko: 법정 최대5회는 실제 처방 authorization을 대신하지 않는다. Authorized none이면 일반 refill 허가가 없다. Original fill과 refill count도 별개다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
Current Massachusetts Legislature text retrieved 2026-11-03

propositions.option_text: A receiving pharmacy obtains the original issue and dispensing history required for an eligible III–V refill transfer.
propositions.finding_ko: III-V refill transfer에는 original issue date와 original dispensing, remaining refills, previous history, pharmacy/pharmacist 등 지정 정보가 필요하다. Eligible라는 조건을 적용한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist treats an unexpired Schedule VI prescription as allowing unlimited refills without remaining prescriber authorization.
propositions.finding_ko: VI의1년 validity는 unlimited refill authorization이 아니다. Prescriber가 부여한 remaining refills가 필요하고 stem은 emergency continuity 예외를 제외한다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register #1536, footer12/6/2024
Current Massachusetts Legislature text retrieved 2026-11-03

propositions.option_text: Both pharmacies use two years from the first transfer as the only retention endpoint even when a later refill extends the required period.
propositions.finding_ko: III-V refill transfer 기록은 last refill로부터2년이다. First transfer기준만 적용하면 이후 refill이 요구 보관기간을 연장하는 사실을 놓친다. Initial EPCS transfer규칙과 다르다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist fills a Schedule III refill after the six-month issue-date limit because the unused refill count is positive.
propositions.finding_ko: CIII prescription의6개월은 issue date기준이다. 사용하지 않은 refill이 남아도 기간을 연장하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist changes the original issue date to keep the existing III–IV prescription active beyond its legal limits.
propositions.finding_ko: 기존 III-IV의 issue date를 고쳐6개월·refill 제한을 우회할 수 없다. 한계 밖의 추가량에는 new separate prescription이 필요하다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist preserves the original issue date and remaining refills when transferring a prescription.
propositions.finding_ko: 이전은 원 발행일과 실제 remaining authorization을 유지한다. 전자 이전도 data를 바꾸거나 사용한 refill을 복원하는 과정이 아니다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist replenishes the original number of refills when the prescription moves to a new pharmacy.
propositions.finding_ko: Pharmacy가 바뀌어도 used refills가 복원되지 않는다. 전달하는 것은 remaining refills와 실제 dispensing history다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
Current Massachusetts Legislature text retrieved 2026-11-03

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist records refill date, quantity, and dispensing pharmacist identification.
propositions.finding_ko: MA III-VI refill은 dispensing date, amount, pharmacist initials를 기록해야 한다. Federal III-IV도 date, quantity, pharmacist identification 등 기록이 필요하다. 이 세 항목만으로 모든 연방 기록이 완결된다고 읽지 않는다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register #1536, footer12/6/2024
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist uses only the insurance claim number as the complete refill record.
propositions.finding_ko: 보험 claim number 하나는 date/quantity/dispensing pharmacist 등 법정 refill 기록을 대체하지 못한다.

authorities.version: Mass.Register #1536, footer12/6/2024
eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A receiving pharmacy accepts only drug name and today’s date as the complete III–V refill-transfer record.
propositions.finding_ko: III-V transfer의 complete record에는 약명과 오늘 날짜 외에 원 처방·refill·약국/DEA·pharmacist 정보가 필요하다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: Both pharmacies preserve the applicable III–V refill-transfer records for at least two years from the last refill.
propositions.finding_ko: Original/transferred III-V refill prescriptions는 last refill date로부터2년 보관한다. 문장은 최소보관이며 다른 적용 의무를 면제하지 않는다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed
Mass.Register #1536, footer12/6/2024

propositions.option_text: An ordinary technician requests an unchanged authorized refill and refers a newly proposed dose change to the pharmacist.
propositions.finding_ko: Pharmacist 승인 등 다른 요건 아래 ordinary technician은 unchanged authorized refill을 요청할 수 있다. 새 dose modification은 pharmacist에게 넘기는 구분이 맞다.

authorities.version: 4/25/2025 corrected publication, printed Effective4/6/2018

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist rejects a Schedule III refill after the six-month issue-date limit even when a refill remains on the record.
propositions.finding_ko: CIII는 unused refill 유무와 별개로 issue date후6개월 제한이 적용된다. Stem이 별도 continuity 예외를 배제한다.

authorities.version: eCFR current Title21, up to date2026-10-30; exact section current as displayed

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist distinguishes an authorized generic marketed under the brand NDA from a separate ANDA product.
propositions.finding_ko: Authorized generic은 brand NDA아래 판매되며 별도 ANDA generic과 regulatory relationship이 다르다. 같은 회사라는 사정만으로 authorized generic이라고 추정하지 않는다.

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist changes an immediate-release prescription to an extended-release product with the same ingredient and strength without clarification.
propositions.finding_ko: IR과 ER은 같은 ingredient/strength라도 pharmaceutical alternatives이다. Known intended formulation과 다른 release form을 clarification없이 자동 대체하지 않는다. 모든 제형·route·TE관계 및 MA interchange법을 함께 확인한다.

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist refuses an otherwise lawful pharmacy-to-pharmacy transfer based on the patient label’s federal transfer warning.
propositions.finding_ko: 21 CFR290.5 경고는 처방받은 환자 이외 사람에게 약물을 양도하는 뜻이다. 적법한 pharmacist prescription-information transfer를 금지하는 조문이 아니다. Refusal이 일반적으로 금지된다는 뜻이 아니라 제시한 federal-warning 법적 근거가 성립하지 않는다는 판정이다.

propositions.option_text: A pharmacist gives a reconstituted medication a one-year label date without considering its shorter in-use limit.
propositions.finding_ko: 더 짧은 product-specific in-use limit를 고려하지 않고1년을 주는 처리는 지지되지 않는다. 실제 공식 amoxicillin suspension label은 reconstitution후14일 discard를 명시한다. 이 예시의14일을 모든 재구성약에 일반화하거나 미확인 USP 원문을 검증했다고 하지 않는다.
